text:
QUOTE: "`scope.not_indexed` lists extensions that were never read: `.rs=2`, `.toml=2`, `.csv=3`, `.sql=1`, `.lock=1`, `.jsonl=1`, `.motor=1`, and 3 extensionless files. A miss in those is "never looked," not "absent,"..."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The item requires naming file types that were in scope and produced no rows. The answer names file types that were not indexed (`not_indexed`), which is the opposite set, and says nothing about in-scope types with zero rows.
